title: VTC — Network membership
description: A community's membership of a Verifiable Trust Network (VTN), and the groups it registered for the network's roles. Shared by the vtc/networks/* tasks.

url.description: Where the network's API is reached: the base its `/.well-known/vtn` profile is served under.

name.description: The network's name, as its profile gives it.

state.description: `acknowledged`: the community is a member — it signed the acknowledgement of the network's grant. `repudiated`: the community rejected the network's listing of it. `departed`: the community left, by repudiating the grant.

listing.description: The network's listing credential naming the community, as the community verified it.

grant.description: The network's membership grant (VMC), once the community acknowledged.

acknowledgement.description: The community's acknowledgement (VMC carrying the grant's digest).

repudiation.description: The community's repudiation (VSC) of the listing, or — on departure — of the grant.

role.description: A role the network defines, e.g. `admins`: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

groupId.description: The community's identifier for the group.

groupDid.description: The group's own DID, which the registration names as its `group`.

endpoint.description: Where the network delivers broadcasts for the group: the community's Trust Task endpoint, at which the network sends them as `vtc/networks/deliver`.

registration.description: The registration: the community's signed `vtn/groups/register` request as the network accepted it — a complete Trust Task document, with its proof, naming the network as `recipient` and the group, `role` and `endpoint` in its payload.

acceptance.description: The network's `groupRegistered/1` statement (VSC) accepting the registration: subject the group, `object.digestMultibase` the registration's digest — SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the signed request including its proof.

role.description: A role the network defines, e.g. `admins`: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

groupId.description: The community group to serve the role.
